reasoning-content.mimics: DeepSeek-style API and llama.cpp --reasoning-format deepseek: reasoning in delta.reasoning_content

reasoning.mimics: vLLM (current) and OpenRouter plain text: reasoning in delta.reasoning

alias-both.mimics: A gateway that sends the same reasoning under both delta.reasoning_content and delta.reasoning

think-tag-split.mimics: llama.cpp --reasoning-format none: <think> tags in content, tags cut across chunks

think-open-omitted.mimics: Chat templates that put <think> into the prompt: the stream only has the closing tag

legacy-both.mimics: llama.cpp --reasoning-format deepseek-legacy: <think> stays in content AND reasoning_content is filled

literal-tag-in-answer.mimics: A model that explains tags in its answer: "<think>" is part of the answer, not a reasoning block

tool-call-deepseek.reasoning: I need the weather. Call the tool.
tool-call-deepseek.mimics: DeepSeek thinking mode with a tool call (reasoning_content, then tool_calls)

openrouter-details.mimics: OpenRouter: delta.reasoning plus delta.reasoning_details blocks that must be sent back unchanged

korean-reasoning.mimics: Korean reasoning inside <think> tags: multi-byte characters that can be cut inside the SSE bytes
